# Inventory reservations

`Inventory.reserve(sku, quantity, on_attempt=None)` returns a reservation ID, or
`None` when insufficient stock remains. IDs are positive and unique. A successful
reservation decreases available stock once and appears in `reservations` once;
rejection changes neither. Quantity must be a positive integer and SKU must exist.
`on_attempt`, when supplied, is invoked exactly once before this request's
state transition. It may synchronously submit another reservation, as a queue
consumer can do while the first request is waiting. Those requests must obey
the same stock invariant regardless of order. Other SKUs are independent.
